describes: packages/plugin/annotation: create/update/delete, the optimistic effects and their rollback, selection, props and flags, text editing, settings and projections.

cases.name: create-programmatically
cases.covers: create() defaults an absent /F to print and sends an explicit one verbatim, then syncs the created DTO (vector, or baked for a stamp) and resolves its ref. An engine refusal rejects; a page the document does not have rejects with the NotFound page() throws.

cases.name: update-and-delete-by-ref
cases.covers: update() and delete() resolve the page from the model (or an index ref’s own pon), await the engine, and sync or remove. An unknown ref rejects with the page error; an engine refusal rejects and changes nothing.

cases.name: selection-reads
cases.covers: select (a group member takes its group, add extends), selection, getSelection and getSelected (drafts skipped), deselect, and the selection flags and props (shared specs, first values, mixed keys, the derived link value).

cases.name: restyle-writes-and-rolls-back
cases.covers: updateSelection is optimistic: each selected member takes the keys its kind declares, and one scoped engine write per changed member re-syncs from the returned DTO (bumping the appearance only on the engine’s say-so). A refused write rolls the member back to its last committed DTO.

cases.name: flags-writes
cases.covers: updateSelectionFlags merges /F over the selection and writes the full flag set per changed member, re-syncing with the member’s own render source; a refused write reports to console.error. It works on a locked annotation (that is how one unlocks).

cases.name: delete-and-rotate-the-selection
cases.covers: deleteSelection removes optimistically and fires one engine delete per committed member, whatever it answers; rotateSelection90 and resetSelectionRotation commit one geometry patch per rotatable member.

cases.name: drawn-shape-commits
cases.covers: A createPointer drag commits a draft: the create effect sends the repository draft (with the seeded /NM and /F), reconciles the temp id to the durable ref, and syncs the DTO as vector. A refused create drops the draft.

cases.name: free-text-editing
cases.covers: beginTextEdit and beginTextEditAt (a hit on a free-text body or handle opens it; anything else reports false), setContents (optimistic, debounced 250ms per annotation, restarted by the next keystroke), endTextEdit (flushes the committed contents at once and cancels the timers), textItems and currentEditing.

cases.name: text-commits-debounce-per-annotation
cases.covers: Each annotation keeps its own debounce timer: typing into a second one neither cancels nor takes over the first one’s, and one firing leaves the other’s pending timer to be restarted, so each commits its last contents once.

cases.name: live-link-targets-and-finishing-a-draft
cases.covers: linkItemsOn reads a link’s target from the model, so an optimistic retarget shows before the engine answers; finishCreationDraft commits a poly draft.

cases.name: settings
cases.covers: setDefaults and currentDefaults through a tool’s preset (arrow reads its own bag; a bare subtype falls back), propsForTool through the tool’s props kind, setSnap and snapSettings, setChrome (deep merge) and chromeSettings, and chrome() dropping the rotate guides when they are disabled.

cases.name: render-projections
cases.covers: pageItems (memoized by model, ghost and view), appearanceEpoch (baked, committed, painting annotations only), bakeScale (identity under the continuous policy), toContentBox, linkItemsOn (standalone and attached links, hidden ones excluded, the /AA hover flags), creationDraftAnchor.

cases.name: memoized-selectors-and-edges
cases.covers: The memoized selectors answer from cache while their inputs are unchanged and recompute on a view change; pointer intents carry zoom and display rotation; an unknown page has no page box; endTextEdit with nothing open is a plain end; a free-text with null contents flushes an empty string; a flags or props write on a draft that has no ref yet sends nothing.
